discoveries.headline: A lane called Vico Passaro still climbs through the old town of San Bartolomeo in Galdo, where Michael was born in 1884.

source.text: OpenStreetMap, via Photon search

discoveries.changeNote: The street name on Michael's birth act was a hard reading; a lane of that name today supports it.

discoveries.headline: The family's 1925 home at 39 Albemarle is now on the map, on Albemarle Avenue in New Rochelle.

source.text: US Census Bureau geocoder

discoveries.headline: Sammy and Virginia's 1930 wedding house, 251 West Maple Avenue in Birmingham, Michigan, is now pinned on today's West Maple Road.

source.text: US Census Bureau geocoder and OpenStreetMap

discoveries.headline: Wykagyl Country Club, where Sammy started in golf as a shop boy, is now pinned at 1195 North Avenue, New Rochelle.

source.text: US Census Bureau geocoder

discoveries.headline: Shenecossett, Sammy's 1942 club, is the Shennecossett Golf Course in Groton, Connecticut, just across the river from New London.

source.text: OpenStreetMap Nominatim

discoveries.headline: Frank's 1942 workplace near Kercheval and Conner in Detroit is now on the map at that corner.

source.text: OpenStreetMap, via Photon search

discoveries.headline: Saginaw Country Club, named with Joe in a 1934 newspaper headline, is now on the map at the club grounds in Saginaw Township, Michigan.

source.text: OpenStreetMap Nominatim

discoveries.headline: Giuseppe Circelli had a younger brother: Giovanniangelo, born at home in San Bartolomeo in Galdo on 27 February 1830 to Donato Circelli and Vincenza Minichiello.

source.text: Birth act 51 of 1830, San Bartolomeo in Galdo (Antenati)

discoveries.imageAlt: Handwritten 1830 birth register page for Giovanniangelo Circelli

discoveries.headline: Giovanniangelo Circelli, a farmer of twenty-five, married Maria d'Andrea in San Bartolomeo in Galdo on 1 November 1855, with his parents' death acts filed alongside.

source.text: Marriage promise act 44 of 1855, San Bartolomeo in Galdo (Antenati)

discoveries.imageAlt: Handwritten 1855 marriage register page for Giovanniangelo Circelli

discoveries.headline: A son, Pasqualantonio, born on 16 March 1862 to Giovanni Circelli and Maria d'Andrea, is very probably Giovanniangelo's: same wife, same late father Donato.

source.text: Birth act 90 of 1862, San Bartolomeo in Galdo (Antenati)

discoveries.imageAlt: Handwritten 1862 birth register page for Pasqualantonio Circelli

discoveries.headline: There were two Donato Circellis: a younger one, born about 1804, was the father of Matteo and of a Giovanni born in February 1830 to Lucia Catalano.

source.text: Birth act 33 of 1830 and marriage act 11 of 1852, San Bartolomeo in Galdo (Antenati)

discoveries.changeNote: Confirms the November 2026 decision to unlink Matteo from Giuseppe's father.

discoveries.headline: Frances Towey's Irish-born parents, James and Margaret Towey, now have their own places in the tree.

source.text: 1900 and 1910 U.S. censuses, New Rochelle; Find a Grave memorials 281144260 and 281144407

discoveries.headline: James Towey, Frances's father, died in New Rochelle on 4 September 1945 and is buried at Holy Sepulchre Cemetery.

source.text: New York State death index 1945, certificate 54299; Find a Grave memorial 281144260

discoveries.headline: Margaret Towey was born in Ireland about 1870, and her grave is at Holy Sepulchre Cemetery in New Rochelle with her husband James.

source.text: 1900 U.S. census, New Rochelle; Find a Grave memorial 281144407

discoveries.headline: Margaret Towey, Frances's mother, died in New Rochelle on 24 January 1938

source.text: New York State death index 1938, certificate 3541; Find a Grave memorial 281144407

discoveries.headline: Frances's brother James, a detective, died in 1935 and her sister Mary Helen Walsh in 1937; her youngest brother lived until 1987.

source.text: New York State death index 1935 and 1937; Find a Grave memorial 281145747

discoveries.headline: The state death index dates Frances Towey Belfiore's death to 15 April 1967, ten days after the date we had, and she is buried at Holy Sepulchre.

source.text: New York State death index 1967, certificate 32075; Find a Grave memorial 281145747

discoveries.changeNote: The Social Security index date of 5 April 1967 is kept as the main date until the certificate is read.

discoveries.headline: Maria Donata Circelli Belfiore, who died in 1937, is buried at Holy Sepulchre Cemetery in New Rochelle.

source.text: Find a Grave memorial 328410140

discoveries.headline: An Anthony Belfiore who died on 11 July 1938 is buried at Holy Sepulchre, the cemetery where Marie D. Belfiore and Michael lie, which strengthens the case that he is Leonardantonio.

source.text: Find a Grave memorial 328799813

discoveries.headline: Found the 1816 birth of Vincenzo Antonio Circelli, the earliest known child of Donato Circelli and Vincenza Minichillo and an elder brother of Giuseppe.

source.text: San Bartolomeo in Galdo, Nati 1816, act 16 (Antenati)

discoveries.headline: Read the 1867 birth act of Maria Bartolomea Circelli, whose father Giovanni, son of the late Donato and aged 37, is Giovanniangelo.

source.text: San Bartolomeo in Galdo, Nati 1867, act 220 (Antenati)

discoveries.headline: Found Maria Bartolomea Circelli's 1890 marriage, which shows her parents Giovanniangelo and Maria D'Andrea were both still living.

source.text: San Bartolomeo in Galdo, Matrimoni 1890, act 20 (Antenati)

discoveries.headline: Rechecked Frances Towey Belfiore's death date: two indexes say 15 April 1967 and nothing supports 5 April, so 15 April now leads.

source.text: NYS death index cert 32075; Find a Grave 281145747; Social Security Death Index

discoveries.changeNote: Earlier the site led with 5 April 1967 and showed 15 April as an alternate. Now 15 April leads and 5 April is the alternate.

discoveries.headline: Found Dorothy Hennessy's birth in the New York City index: 20 February 1922, Manhattan, the same day Find a Grave gives.

source.text: New York City Birth Index 1910 to 1965 (Ancestry)

discoveries.headline: Found Mary Belfiore's marriage record indexed with her parents' names, Antonio Belfiore and Maria D. Circelli.

source.text: New York County Marriages index (Ancestry), FamilySearch film 001031488

discoveries.headline: The 1930 census says Patrick J. Hennessy first married at 21, about 1898 or 1899, which fits a son Joseph born about 1898.

source.text: 1930 United States census, New Rochelle (Ancestry)

discoveries.headline: In the 1920 census Frances Towey, 22 and still single, was a department store bookkeeper living with her family on Mechanic Street.

source.text: 1920 U.S. census, New Rochelle Ward 2 (Ancestry)

discoveries.headline: Her youngest son's 1987 obituary index names Frances's mother as Margaret Coolahan, matching the Collohan maiden name on her memorial.

source.text: Obituary index for her youngest son, 1987 (Ancestry); Find a Grave 281144407

discoveries.headline: Vogue's March 1935 wedding list names Joe's wife as Ruth Hartman O'Donnell and dates their wedding to November 20, 1934, under Duluth.

source.text: Vogue, March 1 1935, 'Good Weddings' (Internet Archive scan)

discoveries.headline: The New York Times printed Joe as 'Joe Belfore, Sunningdale' in tournament lists from September 1927 to September 1929, his club years before Florida and Michigan.

source.text: The New York Times, 17 September 1927 to 26 September 1929 (Internet Archive scans)

discoveries.headline: A 1929 Times tournament list prints Joe Belfore of Sunningdale one line above Pat Circelli of New Rochelle, who shares the surname of Joe's mother; no kinship is known.

source.text: The New York Times, 26 September 1929 (Internet Archive scan)

discoveries.headline: The Veterans Affairs gravesite locator lists Joseph C. Belfiore as a Second World War Navy veteran (ARM1) buried at Calverton National Cemetery, with birth and death dates that match his state death index entry.

source.text: VA Nationwide Gravesite Locator

discoveries.headline: A New York Times death notice of October 7, 1929 shows that Patrick Hennessy's son Joseph Patrick had just died, leaving four children, which makes him the likeliest father of Dorothy (still a deduction).

source.text: The New York Times, 7 October 1929, death notices (Internet Archive scan)

discoveries.headline: In June 1932 'Detectives Towey and Campbell' of New Rochelle arrested the cab driver questioned in the Lindbergh case; Towey is very probably Frances's brother James.

source.text: Victoria Daily Times, 11 June 1932 (Internet Archive scan)

discoveries.headline: A hometown story: in 1884 a San Bartolomeo bugler named Bartolomeo Circelli won a medal in Naples for stopping a soldier's rampage, and he was killed in a street fight at home in 1885. No link to our Circelli families is known.

source.text: Gazzetta Ferrarese, 28 February 1885 (Internet Archive scan)
